preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The size of the good superset m must be between n and 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in superset)
postconditions.description: All points in the superset must have coordinates within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2 or any((x3, y3) in superset for x3, y3 in [(x1, y2), (x2, y1)])) for x2, y2 in superset) for x1, y1 in superset)
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions must be true.
